origin.spread_to: North America via French colonists (18th century)
origin.name_change: Around 1899, Nevada casinos offered 10:1 bonus for Ace of Spades + Jack of Spades/Clubs

milestones.event: First legalized gambling in New Orleans
Nevada legalized gambling, blackjack became casino staple
Edward Thorp published 'Beat the Dealer', introducing card counting

famous_players.name: Edward Thorp
famous_players.contribution: First to mathematically prove card counting works

famous_players.name: Ken Uston
famous_players.contribution: Popularized card counting, fought casino banning

casino_evolution.vegas_golden_nugget: First casino to ban card counters (1960s)
casino_evolution.automated_shufflers: Continuous shuffling machines to counter counting
casino_evolution.live_dealer: Online casinos with real dealers via video stream
